title: Saving `TreeSummarizedExperiment`s to artifacts and back again
text: alabaster.treese package implements methods save TreeSummarizedExperiment objects file artifacts load back R. extends alabaster.sce, handles everything SingleCellExperiment parent class. Check alabaster.base details motivation concepts alabaster framework.

title: Saving `TreeSummarizedExperiment`s to artifacts and back again
text: Given TreeSummarizedExperiment, can use saveObject() save inside staging directory: can load back session readObject().
code: # Mock up a TreeSE with a row tree and reference sequences. library(TreeSummarizedExperiment) data(tinyTree) mat <- matrix(rpois(100, 10), ncol = 10) rownames(mat) <- tinyTree[["tip.label"]] colnames(mat) <- letters[1:10]  tse <- TreeSummarizedExperiment(list(counts = mat), rowTree = tinyTree) tse[["stuff"]] <- LETTERS[1:10] referenceSeq(tse) <- Biostrings::DNAStringSet(rep("ACGT", nrow(tse))) tse ## class: TreeSummarizedExperiment  ## dim: 10 10  ## metadata(0): ## assays(1): counts ## rownames(10): t2 t7 ... t5 t3 ## rowData names(0): ## colnames(10): a b ... i j ## colData names(1): stuff ## reducedDimNames(0): ## mainExpName: NULL ## altExpNames(0): ## rowLinks: a LinkDataFrame (10 rows) ## rowTree: 1 phylo tree(s) (10 leaves) ## colLinks: NULL ## colTree: NULL ## referenceSeq: a DNAStringSet (10 sequences) # Save it into a staging directory. library(alabaster.treese) tmp <- tempfile() saveObject(tse, tmp)  list.files(tmp, recursive = TRUE) ##  [1] "_environment.json"                      ##  [2] "assays/0/array.h5"                      ##  [3] "assays/0/OBJECT"                        ##  [4] "assays/names.json"                      ##  [5] "column_data/basic_columns.h5"           ##  [6] "column_data/OBJECT"                     ##  [7] "OBJECT"                                 ##  [8] "reference_sequences/names.txt.gz"       ##  [9] "reference_sequences/OBJECT"             ## [10] "reference_sequences/sequences.fasta.gz" ## [11] "row_data/basic_columns.h5"              ## [12] "row_data/OBJECT"                        ## [13] "row_links/basic_columns.h5"             ## [14] "row_links/OBJECT"                       ## [15] "row_trees/0/list_contents.h5"           ## [16] "row_trees/0/OBJECT"                     ## [17] "row_trees/names.json" # Load the TreeSE back from disk. roundtrip <- readObject(tmp) class(roundtrip) ## [1] "TreeSummarizedExperiment" ## attr(,"package") ## [1] "TreeSummarizedExperiment"

title: Saving `TreeSummarizedExperiment`s to artifacts and back again
text: tree rowTree() colTree() saved list containing fields phylo object, edge matrix split parent child vectors. use Newick preserve node numbering (referenced rowLinks() colLinks()) labels containing special characters. Users need Newick file tools can always create one ape::write.tree(). links saved data frames, referenceSeq() saved FASTA via alabaster.string.

text: Everything inherited SingleCellExperiment parent class saved alabaster.sce. DNAStringSetList saved list sequence sets.
